author: SethRogensOldrBrothr
body:
Second DeSimone's in HB. I buy the bread all the time to make cheesesteaks.

Fu Wing Low in Fountain Valley. Kenny and his wife started, probably way back in the 80s, and now the kids are running it. Went a few months back and they haven't lost a step. Been going there almost 30 years.

author: inthefade95
body:
I recently started making POV food videos. These are all spots I have covered. Not trying to promote myself, but if you’re 420 friendly and like POV food videos, I’ll include links. I can honestly say I did not regret spending my money at any of these places.

Huckleberry’s HB - Broasted chicken and sandwiches. Carol is awesome and makes one heck of a cashew chicken salad.

[https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUMMyH/](https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUMMyH/)

DeSimone’s HB - top notch Cuban sandwich, Chef Special (turkey and pastrami) is amazing too. Can’t go wrong with any of their sandwiches or desserts.

[https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUFn7s/](https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUFn7s/)

Taste of Brazil - Opposite of Fogo. Nestled in the back corner of plaza on Beach Blvd.

[https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUFJMm/](https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUFJMm/)

The Lost Vine - Wine bar in Tustin. $30 bottle and charcuterie on Saturdays. Happy Hour too. Menu is small but solid. Chicken pot pie is tasty. Had some blue cheese from there like a month ago and still talking about it.

[https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gD7jQw/](https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gD7jQw/)

Adana Mediterranean Grill in Fountain Valley - Well seasoned/marinated chicken kebabs. The cheese pide boat and Lahmacun were all tasty. They have a chef special that feeds up to five people for $90 or 10 people. Seating is funky so take out or sit outside might be better.

[https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUjCSw/](https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUjCSw/)

West Grove Pizza Co in Garden Grove - Tasty pizza and was equally as good cold the next day. They also sell gelato that is made in house.

[https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gDWbgr/](https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gDWbgr/)

La Porteña in Santa Ana - Argentinian food. Located in the back of liquor store on Tustin Ave, between 1st and 4th.

[https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUYsT5/](https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gUYsT5/)

Reynolds Sandwich in Tustin - I’ve never seen such a beautifully rolled breakfast burrito. The turkey pesto panini was tasty too.

[https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gULfTQ/](https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZP8gULfTQ/)
